constraints.name: account_role_audit_action_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ROLE_GRANTED'::character varying, 'ROLE_REVOKED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (actor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((previous_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Learner'::character varying, 'Administrator'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((new_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Learner'::character varying, 'Administrator'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((previous_role)::text <> (new_role)::text)) OR (((action_type)::text = 'ROLE_MANAGER_BOOTSTRAPPED'::text) AND (actor_account_id IS NULL) AND (previous_role IS NULL) AND (new_role IS NULL))))

constraints.name: assessment_terms_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['draft'::character varying, 'published'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])::text[])) AND (version_no > 0)))

constraints.name: assessment_blueprint_assessment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id) REFERENCES assessment(assessment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: assessment_blueprint_counts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((max_questions > 0) AND (target_mcq >= 0) AND (target_sql >= 0) AND (target_essay >= 0) AND (((target_mcq + target_sql) + target_essay) = max_questions)))

constraints.name: assessment_question_assessment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id) REFERENCES assessment(assessment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: session_release_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((result_release_policy)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['IMMEDIATE'::character varying, 'HUMAN_VERIFIED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (review_revision >= 0) AND ((release_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['unsubmitted'::character varying, 'auto_grading'::character varying, 'pending_review'::character varying, 'reviewed'::character varying, 'published'::character varying, 'grading_failed'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: clo_review_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((mapping_source)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['admin'::character varying, 'ai'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: grading_job_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: question_terms_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['bank'::character varying, 'ai_generated'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['draft'::character varying, 'validated'::character varying, 'retired'::character varying])::text[])) AND (points > (0)::numeric) AND (version_no > 0)))

constraints.name: tag_review_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((tag_source)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['admin'::character varying, 'ai'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((review_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[])) AND (confirmed = ((review_status)::text = 'confirmed'::text))))

constraints.name: question_translation_question_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES question(question_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: refresh_session_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(account_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: session_start_request_session_id_learner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, learner_id) REFERENCES assessment_session(session_id, learner_id)
